convert.-s: Skip conversion of rules that can't be handled by the backend
convert.--skip-unsupported: Skip conversion of rules that can't be handled by the backend
convert.--fail-unsupported: Skip conversion of rules that can't be handled by the backend
convert.--output: Write result to specified file. '-' writes to standard output. Mutually exclusive with
convert.-od: Write individual converted rules to separate files in this directory. Mutually exclusive with --output.
convert.--output-filename-template: Template for output filenames when using
convert.--encoding: Output encoding for string backend outputs. This is ignored for backends that return binary output. [default: utf-8]
convert.--json-indent: Pretty-print and indent JSON output with given indentation width per level.
convert.--backend-option: Backend-specific options provided as key=value pair.
convert.--enable-template-vars: Enable template variable support in processing pipeline. WARNING: This feature can be dangerous and allow arbitrary code execution if used with untrusted Sigma rules.
convert.--template-vars-path: Allowed paths for template variable expansion. Can be specified multiple times.
